items.prompt: Style: a hand-made picture-book illustration, inked and painted. Line art in dark umber and deep forest-green ink, never pure black: the lines vary in weight, taper at their ends and sometimes break off or stop short of closing a shape. Colors are opaque gouache with visible dry-brush strokes and the grain of watercolor paper showing through. The characters are inked carefully; the background is painted looser, with fewer lines, soft brush edges and simple masses. Wood grain, knit and cloth are suggested with a few confident strokes, not rendered everywhere. Muted, earthy palette: rust, ochre, moss green, slate blue and warm brown, with cool blue-gray shadows. The scene: a tiny camp on the coast rocks beside a tide pool at low tide, at blue hour in the fog, seen from a crab's height: a little lean-to of three bleached driftwood sticks, with a strip of dried bull kelp laid over its ridge pole, stands on a flat rock ledge at the pool's edge, where five small friends share a thermos of cocoa by a hanging paper lantern while the tide is out; nothing else is there, no buildings, no boats, no lighthouse and no camp clutter. Foreground: along the bottom edge, the near rim of the tide pool: a few broad, flat, dark rocks crusted with mussels and barnacles, painted simply; on the right, the near part of the tide pool, clear still water over a few green sea anemones and a strand of seaweed. Midground: on a flat rock ledge left of center, under a little lean-to of three bleached driftwood sticks with a strip of dried bull kelp laid over its ridge pole and a small lit paper lantern hanging from the front of the ridge pole on a short cord: the sea otter sits holding a clay mug of cocoa on its belly in both paws, a dented tin thermos standing on the rock beside it, and the ochre sea star sits next to the otter; the decorator crab sits on a small rock just below the lantern. Right of center the tufted puffin stands on the pool's rim with its rod over its shoulder reaching out over the tide pool, the line hanging straight down from the rod's tip to the red-and-white float resting on the still water. The tide pool is wide, flat and calm, softly mirroring the fog, with a few rocks breaking its surface. Background: past the pool, low-tide rocks run out toward the sea, and on the outer rocks in the right third stands the black oystercatcher, small, looking out to sea. Beyond them the sea at low tide lies gray-green and calm, with low swells and a thin line of soft white foam where it washes around the base of the far rocks. Two or three tall sea stacks with a few wind-bent spruces on top stand in the fog, the farther ones fading to pale flat shapes, and soft banks of fog lie low over the water. No moon, no stars, no sun and no sunset colors. The air near the camera is clear: no rain. Also in view: the paper lantern hanging from the lean-to's ridge pole; the flat top of the rock along the tide pool's near rim; open foggy sky over the sea; the flat top of a far sea stack; the still water of the tide pool. The characters, drawn exactly as described: (1) a northern sea otter: round and plump, with thick dark brown fur, a pale cream face and head, small round ears, short whiskers, big webbed hind feet, a short flat tail and two tiny black dot eyes without shine, with a long strand of bull kelp wrapped once around its neck like a scarf, the kelp's round bulb and both long ribbon-like ends hanging down in front of its chest. (2) a graceful decorator crab: a small crab with long spindly legs whose back is a tiny garden of moss, a curled fern frond and a little mushroom; its face is at the front of its shell, below the garden, with two tiny black dot eyes on short stalks and a small mouth, and it has no other eyes. (3) a tufted puffin: round and plump, black all over with a white face, a big orange-red bill with a yellow base, orange feet, long straw-yellow tufts sweeping back from behind its eyes and two tiny black dot eyes without shine, holding a tiny fishing rod in one wing with the rod resting on its shoulder, a thin line and a little red-and-white float hanging straight down from the rod's tip, clear of its body. (4) an ochre sea star: a plump five-armed sea star in deep purple, its skin bumpy with a net of small pale knobs, its small face in its middle with two tiny black dot eyes without shine, and a tuft of frilly green sea lettuce growing from the tip of its top arm like a cowlick. (5) a black oystercatcher: round and plump, sooty black-brown all over, a long straight bright orange-red bill, pale pink legs and two tiny black dot eyes without shine, each in a thin red ring, wearing a little yellow sou'wester rain hat with two long chin ribbons hanging loose under its bill. blue hour in fog: the fog glows a soft, cool blue-gray, palest low over the sea, and the rocks, the pool and the friends' backs sit in cool slate-blue shadow. The puffin catches only a little of it, a dark shape with a pale face against the pale water, and the oystercatcher is a dark silhouette against the fog. The puffin stands on the pool's near rim right of center, with the pool in front of it and beyond it. The oystercatcher is small on the outer rocks in the right third, a clear dark shape against the pale fog. Two or three sea stacks stand in the fog in the background, right of center, and quiet open fog fills the upper right. Each friend stands clear of the others and of the lean-to's sticks.
